items.q: Can I take cannabis on a plane from Newark Airport?
items.a_html: No. Transporting cannabis across state lines or onto a commercial flight is illegal under federal law, regardless of the laws in your destination state. Newark Liberty International Airport is a federally regulated facility, and TSA officers are required to report cannabis discoveries to law enforcement. Purchase what you plan to consume in New Jersey, and do not attempt to bring any cannabis products through security or onto a plane. Lady L is here for your New Jersey experience, not your carry-on.

items.q: How much cannabis can I legally buy?
items.a_html:
Dispensaries are allowed to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams (1 ounce) of usable cannabis per transaction. This can be made up of any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, such as purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to cannabis purchases in New Jersey?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey are subject to a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). All taxes are applied at checkout. Our team can walk you through the breakdown if you have questions.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept at Lady L?

items.q: Where can I legally consume cannabis near Newark International Airport?
items.a_html: New Jersey permits cannabis consumption in private residences. Public spaces, parks, vehicles, and federal property are all off-limits. Newark Liberty International Airport is federal property, so consumption anywhere on airport grounds is not permitted. Plan to consume at your destination once you're settled in a private space. Lady L does not have on-site consumption space.
